services.label: Web and app Chat-AI
services.tech: Web AI for 24/7 service and sales, trained with products, services, prices and contact rules to answer visitors in real time and escalate opportunities.

services.label: Offline on-premise AI
services.tech: Private AI without internet for own servers, designed for confidentiality, data control and operational continuity without permanent external subscriptions.

services.label: Specialized trained AI
services.tech: Model that learns from documents, cases, experience and real data; it can specialize in law, medicine, manufacturing, education, sales or technical support.

intro.title: Build your own AI with your data, online or offline
intro.copy: IA Colombia trains custom models for sales, support, maintenance, legal, analytics and critical processes. You can operate in the cloud, on your own servers, on edge devices or without internet.
intro.insight: The diagnosis identifies what information must be trained, which deployment fits and how to protect sensitive data before building.
intro.optionQuestion: What do you need to solve first?

options.label: Request demo
options.hint: I want to review my case with IA Colombia
options.insight: I want IA Colombia to review my data, process and goal to propose a viable AI route.

options.label: Design my AI
options.hint: I want AI trained with my information
options.insight: I want to create a specialized artificial intelligence that understands my business and evolves with new data.

options.label: Quote integration
options.hint: I want to connect AI to existing systems
options.insight: I want to know how to integrate AI into my website, app, software, CRM, ERP or internal process.

serviceFamily.title: What type of AI does your company need?
serviceFamily.copy: Choose the closest line: trained AI, Chat-AI, offline AI, IA Center, LexIA, Omnia AI or PostAI.
serviceFamily.insight: Each family defines data, infrastructure, security and the monetization or automation model.

options.label: Trained AI
options.insight: I need AI that is expert in my operation, documents, cases, products or internal knowledge.

options.label: Automate with AI
options.insight: I want AI to respond, classify, analyze or trigger processes through web, app or API.

options.label: Create an AI business
options.hint: IA Center or commercial Omnia AI
options.insight: I want to offer trained AI to third parties, sell access or manage models under my brand.

buildType.title: Where should the AI run?
buildType.copy: IA Colombia can deploy models in the cloud, on your own servers, edge devices, websites, apps or offline environments.
buildType.insight: The execution place defines privacy, performance, cost, maintenance and scalability.

options.label: In the cloud
options.insight: I need AI to respond from anywhere, scale users and integrate corporate systems.

options.label: On websites or apps
options.insight: I want to serve users 24/7, answer about products and transfer to a salesperson when needed.

options.label: Without internet
options.insight: I need privacy, operational continuity and local control of sensitive data.

automationType.title: What should AI do for your process?
automationType.copy: It can respond, guide technicians, analyze POST requests, classify documents, support decisions or learn from new records.
automationType.insight: The right automation keeps limits, traceability and human review when risk requires it.

options.label: Process POST requests
options.insight: I need to send structured or unstructured data to receive diagnostics, classifications or predictions.

options.label: Serve customers
options.hint: Chat-AI on web or digital channels
options.insight: I want to answer questions, improve conversion and reduce human workload without losing commercial contact.

options.label: Technical support
options.insight: I want AI to remember failures, solutions and procedures to support operators even without internet.

modernization.title: Do you want AI to operate or to sell AI?
modernization.copy: IA Center and Omnia AI make it possible to build own platforms, manage models, retrain knowledge and offer AI services to companies. IA Center can be hosted on your own servers and under your own brand to create a technology business with subscriptions or access plans.
modernization.insight: The old website presented IA Center as a ChatGPT-style system hosted on owned infrastructure, with full control over data, models, performance and commercial brand.

options.label: IA Center
options.hint: Your own ChatGPT-style center under your brand
options.insight: I want to manage models, users, plans and conversation or automation services for third parties.

options.label: Omnia AI
options.insight: I want to create knowledge models that update with new data and serve multiple industries.

options.label: LexIA or vertical AI
options.hint: Specialized in law or another sector
options.insight: I want to train expert AI in laws, cases, jurisprudence or specialized knowledge.

operation.title: How will it be used in real operation?
operation.copy: AI can be private, public, hybrid, API-connected or locally installed for industrial, government or corporate environments.
operation.insight: Good architecture avoids internet dependency when the company needs continuity or confidentiality.

options.label: Remote users
options.insight: I need access from different offices, teams or clients.

options.label: Plant or sensitive entity
options.insight: I need information to remain inside the company or entity and operate without internet.

options.label: Connected systems
options.hint: CRM, ERP, app, web or backend
options.insight: I need to integrate AI into existing systems without duplicating data or processes.

value.title: What value should it create first?
value.copy: It can reduce customer loss, accelerate sales, improve support, lower costs, improve compliance or turn internal knowledge into a reusable asset.
value.insight: The first module should attack the most costly loss: time, customers, errors, knowledge or continuity.

options.label: Sales and service
options.insight: I want AI to answer about products, prices and requirements, and escalate to a human contact when needed.

options.label: Internal knowledge
options.insight: I want my company to preserve experience, cases and procedures even when staff changes.

options.label: Analytics and decision
options.insight: I want each request or document to return a useful, measurable and traceable answer.

risk.title: What must be protected from the beginning?
risk.copy: IA Colombia considers encryption, granular access control, private deployment, auditing, validations, model limits and compliance support.
risk.insight: Security is not added at the end: it defines architecture, allowed data, permissions and traceability.

options.label: Sensitive data
options.insight: I need to protect documents, customers, processes, legal information or internal data.

options.label: Model accuracy
options.insight: I need to reduce ambiguity, correct answers and keep knowledge updated.

options.label: Critical processes
options.insight: I need limits, logs and human review for important decisions.

finance.title: How do you want to start commercially?
finance.copy: The trained AI service starts at 10,000 USD and includes training, deployment and initial technical support according to the validated scope. Diagnosis organizes scope, phases, infrastructure and priority before committing investment.
finance.insight: Any additional software development, hardware or specialized AI server must be quoted separately. The system can adapt from small companies to large corporations with personalized advice.

options.label: Technical demo
options.insight: I want to validate with examples, understand whether I need cloud, own server or specialized equipment, and confirm AI can solve my case.

options.label: Phased project
options.insight: I want to advance by stages to control risk, investment, data, integration, initial technical support and infrastructure.

options.label: Enterprise proposal
options.insight: I want a proposal with training, deployment, initial technical support, security, hardware, cloud, additional software and personalized advice.

timeline.title: How quickly should it be working?
timeline.copy: A first version can validate data and answers; then it becomes robust with security, integration, retraining and final deployment.
timeline.insight: Speed depends on information availability, data quality, deployment environment and security level.

options.label: Fast demo
options.insight: I want to see a working proof before expanding scope.

options.label: 1 to 3 months
options.insight: I want to train, test, tune and deploy with real users.

options.label: Enterprise route
options.insight: I want a scalable solution with audit, permissions, support and continuous evolution.

summary.title: Your AI route is ready.
summary.copy: IA Colombia can review your decisions, confirm training data, model type, integration, security, deployment and next commercial step.
summary.insight: Send the summary to prepare a clear technical route without losing context.
